questions.question: What is the well-known tale about how Li Bai died?

He was executed by Emperor Xuanzong
He died of famine in Northern China

Incorrect. The article states Li did not live to see the end of the chaos, but does not say he died in battle.

Incorrect. Famine affected Northern China during the rebellion, but Li Bai's death is described by the moon reflection tale.
